}}'''Fennel''' is a farrier in [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Fennel}}

== Appearance ==
He has wide-shoulders.{{ref/book|13|2}}

== Activities ==
Although his nationality is not listed in the books or [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], he is likely Cairhienin like the three other named farriers in Perrin's army [[Aemin]], [[Falton]] and [[Jerasid]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Aemin}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Falton}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jerasid}}

He is one of six farriers with Perrin's army in [[Ghealdan]]. Presumably they were hired after Rand and he return from the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] and before Rand sends Perrin to meet with Queen [[Alliandre Maritha Kigarin]].{{ref/book|8|9}}

He is part of the group sent forward by Perrin while traveling through [[Ghealdan]]. He waits behind for Perrin, to inform him where the forward group has traveled to.{{ref/book|13|2}}

==Trivia==
*Fennel is named after Vincent Fennel, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
